serial_dictatorship.name: Picking rounds
serial_dictatorship.tagline: Everybody pick for im turn, for drawn order.
serial_dictatorship.how: We draw turn order — from di poll token, so anybody fit verify am. Each person, for im turn, go collect im favourite among wetin remain.
pros: Impossible to cheat: sincere ranking na always di best
Very easy to explain and accept
cons: Di last people for di order go collect leftovers
Luck dey weigh heavy for di result
E no look how strong di preferences be

optimal_sum.name: Maximum satisfaction
optimal_sum.tagline: Di sharing wey go please di most people, calculated exact.
optimal_sum.how: Each sharing "cost" di position wey e hold for di person ranking (1st choice = 0, 2nd = 1…). Di Hungarian algorithm go find di sharing with di smallest total cost: di best overall satisfaction, exact.
pros: Di best total satisfaction wey possible
cons: E fit sacrifice one person for common good
E no too easy to explain

top_trading_cycles.name: Trading circle
top_trading_cycles.tagline: Everybody don already own something; win-win swap cycles.
top_trading_cycles.how: Everybody don already own one thing (di Nth person for di list own di Nth thing) and rank all di things. Di algorithm go run swap cycles on di remaining favourites until e finish. Nobody go end up worse pass wetin dem start with.
pros: Nobody go end up worse pass di start
Sincere ranking na always di best
cons: Exactly as many things as people
Di result depend well well on di starting property

stable_roommates.name: Stable pairs
stable_roommates.tagline: Pairs wey nobody get interest to leave.
stable_roommates.how: Everybody rank di oda participants. Irving algorithm go find stable pairs: no two people go prefer each oda pass dia assigned partners. E fit prove say no stable pairing dey exist — den we go announce di fallback: picking rounds for drawn order.
pros: E dey based on both sides preferences
E dey honestly detect impossible cases
cons: Stable pairing no dey always exist
To rank everybody fit take time

gale_shapley.name: Two groups (Parcoursup)
gale_shapley.tagline: Two sides rank each oda; stable matching.
gale_shapley.how: Two groups rank each oda (candidates and programmes, mentees and mentors…). Deferred acceptance (Gale-Shapley) go produce stable matching: no duo go prefer each oda pass dia assignment. Side 1 dey propose — di method favour am; each side-2 entry fit host plenty people (capacities).
pros: E handle capacities (plenty spots per side-2 entry)
Sincere ranking na optimal for side 1
cons: E dey favour di side wey propose
Some people go remain unmatched if spots finish

whenToUse.fptp: Decide fast: one round, di one wey get most votes win.
whenToUse.runoff: Make sure say person get absolute majority, with second round if e necessary.
whenToUse.approval: Plenty acceptable choice: everybody tick all wey dey okay for dem.
whenToUse.condorcet: Pick di one wey win every duel (true agreement).

fptp.name: First-past-the-post
fptp.how: Everybody vote for one candidate. Di one wey get most votes win, even if e no reach clear majority.
pros: Na one trip to di ballot
cons: E dey push people to vote tactical

runoff.name: Two-round runoff
runoff.how: If nobody reach 50%, di top two go face off for second round. Di final winner sure to get absolute majority.
pros: You fit vote your heart for round one
cons: Di third person fit be betta agreement

condorcet.name: Simple Condorcet
condorcet.how: Everybody rank di options. We go simulate every one-on-one duel: di winner na di one wey beat all di oders.
pros: E no dey fall for tactical voting
E hard to manipulate well well

condorcet_random.name: Randomised Condorcet
condorcet_random.tagline: Condorcet, with luck to break di lock.
condorcet_random.how: Like Condorcet, but when di duels dey go round in circle (A>B>C>A), we go draw di winner by luck from di loop wey lock.
cons: E fit surprise you for paradox

mj.name: Majority judgment
mj.tagline: You grade, di majority grade win.
mj.how: Everybody give each option grade (from "Reject" to "Excellent"). Di option wey get di highest median grade win.
pros: E show plenty feeling, no be just one choice

approval.name: Approval voting
approval.tagline: Tick everybody wey you dey okay with.
approval.how: Everybody tick as many options as dem approve. Di one wey most people approve win.
cons: E dey depend on each voter threshold
People no dey use am, dem no sabi am

borda.name: Borda count
borda.how: Everybody rank di options. First place get n-1 points, second n-2, and so on. Add dem: most points win.
pros: E take di whole ranking into account
cons: E fit push aside favourite wey divide people

proportional.name: Proportional representation
proportional.how: Instead of one winner, we go share di seats according to di votes (d'Hondt method). E perfect for assembly.
cons: Di threshold go comot di smallest

indirect.name: Electoral college
indirect.how: We go split voters into constituency. Each one go pick local champion — by whichever count you choose — wey go collect im electors. Di highest elector count win.
cons: Di one wey win popular vote fit still lose
E dey depend on di boundaries

list.name: Party-list vote
list.tagline: Di leading list take half di seats, di rest go proportional.
list.how: You vote for whole list (like French local elections). Di list wey come first automatic get half di seats — di majority bonus — den we go share di oda half proportional among every list wey pass 5%, bonus join.
pros: E give stable majority to govern
cons: E over-represent di winning list well well
Di list leader hold plenty power

AiDoc.metaTitle: Placet for AI — generate voting link
AiDoc.metaDescription: How AI assistant (or human) go generate Placet URL wey go open pre-filled poll draft: format, methods wey dey available, examples.
AiDoc.title: Placet for AI assistants
AiDoc.intro: Placet dey turn group decision into structured vote. You fit generate link wey go open pre-filled draft: di user go check am, adjust am, den launch. You no need any authentication to produce di link.
AiDoc.slackTeaserBody: Start vote without comot from your channel: /placet go build di vote, people go vote for web, and di result go come back for di channel.
AiDoc.paramDescription: — optional context (place, budget, deadline…), wey go show under di question and for di share preview.
AiDoc.paramOptions: — 2 to 8 options wey | separate. Put emoji for front of each option: e go be di icon (e.g. 🍕 Italian|🍣 Japanese).
AiDoc.paramMedia: — optional: one http(s) picture URL per option (image, video, doc), for di same order as options, wey | separate (leave option blank for no picture). Na only real, reliable URLs — no make dem up; if you dey doubt, leave am empty. For plenty images, use di API.
AiDoc.paramDates: — time-slot vote: e replace options with list of ISO dates/times wey | separate (e.g. 2026-07-12T20:00|2026-07-13T12:30). Method wey we recommend: approval (single winner only).
AiDoc.paramSurvey: — SURVEY: survey=1 go turn di result to opinion panorama, nobody go be winner (e good to measure opinions or map situation). Prefer approval (prevalence) or majority_judgment (intensity).
AiDoc.paramScale: — SCALE (majority judgment): scale= pick di grades wey pesin go give each option — agreement, severity (wetin dey weigh), frequency, satisfaction, dissatisfaction, priority. Default na election grades ("Reject … Excellent").
AiDoc.paramAssign: — ASSIGNMENT instead of vote (share things, form pairs): e replace method with one of serial_dictatorship (picking rounds), optimal_sum (maximum satisfaction), top_trading_cycles (trading circle), stable_roommates (stable pairs, even number), gale_shapley (two groups, capacities). options go become di list of things to share (one-sided methods only).
AiDoc.paramParticipants: — assignment participants, wey | separate — each person go get personal ranking link. For gale_shapley, add sideb too: side-2 entries ("Name ; capacity"), wey | separate. For duty rosters/shifts, combine assign with dates (ISO slots) and per (2 to 6): each person go get N slots, di picking order go snake go-and-come.
AiDoc.paramSource: — your name (claude, chatgpt, gemini…): e go show as “Prepared with …”.
AiDoc.paramWhy: — reason (especially for di method choice): e go show to di user to build trust.
AiDoc.formatWarning: ⚠️ No put any sensitive data for di URL (emails, guest lists, credentials, tokens).
AiDoc.apiIntro: If you fit make HTTP requests, POST structured draft and collect back ready-to-open URL (no authentication):
AiDoc.closedNote: For closed poll (voter list, restricted access), use di interface: you no fit set dis ones through URL.

SlackPage.title: Group votes, right inside Slack
SlackPage.intro: Add Placet to your Slack workspace. /placet command go build di vote with your team; voting dey happen for web (with real methods: approval, majority judgment, Condorcet…) and di result go come back for di channel.
SlackPage.installUnavailable: Installation no dey available (setup dey go on).
SlackPage.step1Body: Type “/placet Where we go chop lunch?” (or “/placet dates …” for time slots) for any channel.
SlackPage.step2Body: Everybody go add options and pick di method, right inside di message.
SlackPage.step3Body: When e launch, di channel go get di link: everybody go vote for web, no account needed.
SlackPage.step4Body: When e close (button or deadline), di count and di winner go post for di channel.
SlackPage.permissionsNote: Placet dey request di minimal permissions (commands, chat:write) to post and update voting messages. Ballots dey stay for web; no voter need account. Type /placet help for Slack anytime.
